_comment: Canonical Tribunal document shape. client is the authority - it stores TribunalPolicy records that define named consensus bodies for L2 governance. A Tribunal consists of N member identities (enrolled agentic apps) and requires K affirmative distinct signatures to reach quorum. A field mismatch breaks L2 governance and multi-sig verification.
_consumers: client internal services (L4 Warden, governance verification)

tribunal._description: Named consensus body for L2 governance. Consists of N member identities (enrolled agentic apps via TrustedSigner.ID) and requires K affirmative distinct signatures to reach quorum.

id.description: Tribunal name/identifier. Used as the document ID.

member_app_ids.description: Member app IDs enrolled in this tribunal. Each ID corresponds to a TrustedSigner.ID.

quorum.description: Number of affirmative distinct signatures required to reach quorum (K-of-N).

require_distinct.description: Whether duplicate signer keys are rejected. When true, each signature must come from a distinct signer.

enabled.description: Whether this tribunal is currently enabled for governance participation.
